steam.en: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or local. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android & Steam! Frequent updates. Over sixty Legends.

de.text: Brawlhalla ist ein kostenloses Kampf-Computerspiel, das von Blue Mammoth Games für Microsoft Windows, macOS, PlayStation 4, Xbox One und Nintendo Switch entwickelt wurde.

en.text: Brawlhalla is a free-to-play platform fighting game developed by Blue Mammoth Games. It was originally released for macOS, PlayStation 4 and Windows in 2017, with ports for Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Android and iOS released later. Full cross-play is supported across all platforms.
